title: Create a New Clustered Index Through the Cluster Manager
objectives: Create a New Clustered Index Through the Cluster Manager
Verify the active operational state and explain the evidence.

tasks.instruction: Keep idx01/idx02/idx03 as cluster peers. Direct index creation on a peer is rejected. On cm01, create manager-apps/_cluster/local/indexes.conf for application_logs with distinct home/cold/thawed paths and repFactor=auto.
Run splunk validate cluster-bundle, then splunk apply cluster-bundle and confirm the prompt. Verify the active definition on every peer, not just files on the manager.

hints: Inspect effective configuration and the delivery error before changing a setting.
Creating an index does not add events. Verify the destination, activation and search window independently.

feedback.success: Completion requires active configuration, verified search results and correct evidence answers.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect failed outcomes. Disk changes require activation; data must be ingested explicitly.
